title: NXR — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for NXR.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Value Performance." NXR makes pro-style ranges at entry-level pricing. Stainless steel construction, sealed burners, and convection ovens at prices that make pro-style accessible to first-time buyers. Available at Costco and online retailers.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Costco shoppers. First-time pro-style range buyers on a strict budget.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for NXR:

• Pro-style ranges at Costco pricing

• Sealed burners and convection standard

• Stainless steel construction

• Simple, reliable cooking performance

• Easy availability at Costco and online
